pivot_note: pivot: pixels from the PNG's top-left; model_xy: where the pivot sits at rest (model units, feet at y 0)

body.desc: the tall shadow: violet-black paper with a gilt edge, creased folds, a torn hem; root card, pivot at the hem's middle (0, 0)

body_cracked.desc: cracked: lines of light breaking through (the shatter, stage 1); root card, pivot at the hem's middle (0, 0)

face.desc: the face: a round compass in a gold rim, its dial ticked; the needle is its own card; pivot at the dial's centre

face_open.desc: Hatesong: the dial split open, a dark howling mouth with gold teeth; pivot at the dial's centre

face_cracked.desc: the face cracking with light (the shatter); pivot at the dial's centre

needle.desc: the compass needle (red north); spin it about its pivot, the dial's centre; stop it pointing at the target for Doom Foretold

arm_front.desc: the front arm: an accordion of folded pages ending in a flat page-hand with writing on it; pivot at the shoulder (0, 38)

arm_back.desc: the back arm, a tone darker: an accordion of folded pages ending in a flat page-hand with writing on it; pivot at the shoulder (0, 38)

arm_stub.desc: arm lost: a torn stump of pages at the shoulder; swap for the arm until it regrows

light_shard_0.desc: a shard of the shattered Nightmare, glowing; throw them out and fade them

light_shard_1.desc: a shard of the shattered Nightmare, glowing; throw them out and fade them

light_shard_2.desc: a shard of the shattered Nightmare, glowing; throw them out and fade them

rest_note: model_xy is each card's pivot at rest
